summary: Quiet street of large homes; flattest stretch has houses 13-17 m off.
reasons: Homes 13-17 m away on both sides
Few cars parked along the kerb
Level only near the 125-138 m mark

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 13-17 m away on the south side, others across the road; no open buffer.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with room at the kerb; a few cars park on the north side.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street, local traffic only.
drivers.convention: Some cars parked in the street, but no sign of overnight stays.

flags: Steep elsewhere: mean 6.6%, max 16.8%; best section nearly flat
Low-lying: 8-16 m, Sandy Creek 91 m away
sun_shade: Open kerb; street trees on the north side give some midday shade.

best_section.where: South kerb of Garema Street, about 125 m west of the Moggill Road junction
